title: Spot the Difference
summary: A prisoner is stabbed on a ferry while handcuffed to DI Poole
method: The killer used the rough water as an opportunity to stab the victim. The victim was also not the prisoner, as the guard paid him to switch places. The killer's wife was thrown over the balcony later on.
motive: The killer wanted to get out of prison and get to the $2M that he had stashed away.
